stem: Which statement explains how the First Amendment has affected these groups?
instruction: Study the diagram and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: These groups are allowed to share and promote their beliefs.

options.label: G
options.text: These groups are allowed to join together to form a national religion.

options.label: H
options.text: These groups are prevented from having worship services in public places.

options.label: J
options.text: These groups are prevented from establishing religious schools.
